description: Main source file for a Bluetooth peripheral ISO server implementation using Zephyr RTOS, including connection handling, ISO data processing, and advertising setup.

methods.name: connected
methods.description: Handles Bluetooth connection establishment, logs connection address or error.

methods.name: disconnected
methods.description: Handles Bluetooth disconnection, logs address and reason.

methods.name: iso_print_data
methods.description: Prints first and last three octets of data in hex format, with ellipsis if data is longer.

methods.name: iso_recv
methods.description: Handles incoming ISO data, prints data if valid.

methods.name: iso_connected
methods.description: Logs when an ISO channel is connected.

methods.name: iso_disconnected
methods.description: Logs when an ISO channel is disconnected with reason.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Initializes Bluetooth, loads settings, registers ISO server, starts advertising, and handles errors.
